column2: Search by name, race or nation
A neutral city-state at the center of the continent, an academy founded together by six nations.
We have gathered the stories of the twelve faculties that stand against the gates.
The basic setting of the world around Northeia Academy.
Dimensional doors that appear all over the world.
Subjugation, defeating the boss, is the highest honor.
For new students who must choose a faculty before admission, we help you find the one among the twelve that suits you.
The brooches of the twelve faculties and the Office. Press to take a look.
A year at the Academy. Press an event to open the details.
Six nations, including the Republic of Northeia, jointly sponsor the Academy.
Among the Academy's students, pick your soulmate.
The first time you play, it may take around ten seconds to start while the photos load.
Press a brooch to see only that faculty, then press more to add them one by one. Press a character to open the details.
A place to rest. Enjoy it lightly.
Combine the mana of the six schools, choose a form and cast a spell. The spell names and forms here are for play.
